fields.schemeName: Vasantrao Naik Tanda / Basti Development Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Vasantrao Naik Tanda/Basti Development" is implemented by the Govt. of Maharashtra. The scheme provides essential amenities to the Tandas and Bastis of Vimukta Jatis and Nomadic Tribes. The scheme focuses on improving access to drinking water, electrification, latrines, drainage, etc.

fields.schemeName: Reimbursement of the MS-CIT Course
fields.briefDescription: The Reimbursement of the MS-CIT Course scheme was launched by the Maharashtra Building And Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWW), Labour Department Maharashtra.

fields.schemeName: Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana (Maharashtra)
fields.briefDescription: The "Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana" scheme is implemented by the Social Justice & Special Assistance Department, Government of Maharashtra. This Centrally Sponsored Scheme is aimed at providing insurance and scholarship benefits to landless labourers in rural areas, aged 18 to 59 years.

fields.schemeName: Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Bank: For Horticulture
fields.briefDescription: The scheme offers a horticulture loan to support farmers with funds ranging from ₹25,000/- to ₹2,00,000/- per 0.4 hectare at an interest rate of 11%-12.75%.

fields.schemeName: District Central Cooperative Banks and through its Branches: For Jewel Loan
fields.briefDescription: The scheme allows eligible individuals to obtain loans by pledging their gold and jewelry. The maximum loan amount is ₹1,00,000/- with an interest rate of 12%, subject to changes as per bank policies.

fields.schemeName: Swarnima
fields.briefDescription: The Swarnima Scheme provides loan assistance to female beneficiaries from Other Backward Classes (OBC) residing in Maharashtra to support self-employment activities, empowering them to establish a stable livelihood.

fields.schemeName: Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Bank: Jewel Loans
fields.briefDescription: The scheme offers jewel loans to farmers, enabling them to access up to ₹2,00,000/- at an interest rate of 11.5% for agricultural purposes.

fields.schemeName: Tool/Equipment Purchase Subsidy Scheme (MPBOCWWB)
fields.briefDescription: Launched on January 1, 2018, the "Tool/Equipment Purchase Subsidy Scheme" provides financial assistance to construction workers registered under the M.P. Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board for the purchase of tools and equipment related to their work.

fields.schemeName: Deen Dayal Upadhyay Kaushal Kendra (DDUKK)- Mega Skill Centre
fields.briefDescription: The “Deen Dayal Upadhyay Kaushal Kendra (DDUKK)- Mega Skill Centre” is a component of the umbrella scheme “Mukhymantri Sarthi Yojna” launched by the Department of Labour, Employment, Training and Skill Development, Government of Jharkhand.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Vyavsayik Pathyakram Margdarshan Evam Utpreran Yojana
fields.briefDescription: This initiative offers free coaching to the students belonging to the backward class (BC) and extremely backward class (EBC) of Bihar, helping them prepare for competitive exams like NET, GATE, JRF, Ph.D., and M.Phil.

fields.schemeName: State Scholarship of Class 6th to 10th (Scheduled Caste)
fields.briefDescription: Launched in 1966-67, the "State Scholarship for Class 6th to 10th" is a scheme by the Scheduled Caste Welfare Department, Govt of MP. It provides ₹200 per year for boys and ₹600 per year for girls from Scheduled Caste communities, until 31st October.

fields.schemeName: Nariwal Paudha Vitaran Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aimed at promoting coconut cultivation in non-traditional areas like Bihar. Under this scheme, farmers and urban residents can obtain coconut saplings at a subsidized rate to encourage widespread plantation and utilization.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Bagwani Mission: Anjeer Vikas Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The Scheme aims to expand plantain cultivation across all districts in Bihar. Farmers can receive subsidies for up to 10 acres and access high-quality tissue-cultured plants for cultivation.

fields.schemeName: National Family Assistance Scheme (Madhya Pradesh)
fields.briefDescription: Launched on 15th August 1995, the "National Family Assistance Scheme" by the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Madhya Pradesh provides ₹20,000/- to ensure social security for bereaved families living below the poverty line in case of death of their breadwinner.

fields.schemeName: Incentive For The Inter Caste Marriage Couple (Scheduled Tribe)
fields.briefDescription: The "Incentive for Inter Caste Marriage Couple" scheme was launched by the Tribal Welfare Department, Karnataka. The scheme provides incentives to the couple in which one spouse is from a Scheduled Tribe (ST) and the other spouse is non-ST. An incentive of ₹5,50,000/- is provided to the couple.

fields.schemeName: Self-Certification Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The Labour Department, Government of Tripura, launched the Self-Certification Scheme aims for employers to self-certify their compliance with multiple labor laws, aiming to simplify inspections and reduce bureaucracy.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Anusuchit Jati / Anusuchit Janjati Udyami Yojana
fields.briefDescription: This is a flagship scheme of the Bihar government aimed at promoting entrepreneurship and self-employment among the youth by providing financial assistance for setting up businesses.

fields.schemeName: Free Employment Oriented Training to Educated Unemployed Youth of Backward Class and Minority Class
fields.briefDescription: "Free Employment Oriented Training to Educated Unemployed Youth of Backward Class and Minority Class" aims to provide quality pre-examination training for various employment-oriented competitive examinations to talented but economically disadvantaged young men and women.

fields.schemeName: Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana: Accidental Death
fields.briefDescription: The component “Accidental Death” under the “Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana” launched by the Labour Resources Department, Bihar, provides financial assistance of ₹1,00,000/- to the families of workers or craftsmen in case of accidental death.

fields.schemeName: Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana: Natural Death
fields.briefDescription: The component “Natural Death” under the “Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana” launched by the Labour Resources Department, Bihar, provides financial assistance of ₹30,000/- to the families of workers or craftsmen in case of natural death.

fields.schemeName: Incentives to Students who Passed the Civil Service Examination
fields.briefDescription: The "Incentives to Students Who Passed the Civil Service Examination" scheme provides incentives to Scheduled Tribe candidates who clear the Civil Services exams (Preliminary, Main, and Interview) conducted by M.P. PSC and UPSC.

fields.schemeName: Coaching by Private Institutes for All India Services Civil Services Examination
fields.briefDescription: Launched on 12th September 2013, the scheme "Coaching by Private Institutes for All India Services Civil Services Examination (Scheduled Tribes)" provides financial assistance, education, and training to Scheduled Tribe candidates preparing for the Civil Services Examination.

fields.schemeName: Janani Bal Suraksha Yojana
fields.briefDescription: This health initiative aimed at improving maternal and infant health by increasing institutional deliveries, reducing infant and maternal mortality rates, and promoting immunization in Bihar.

fields.schemeName: Mukhya Mantri Shramik Seva Prasuti Sahayata Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Launched on 1st April 2018, the scheme "Mukhya Mantri Shramik Seva Prasuti Sahayata Yojana" by the Labour Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh, provides maternity support to pregnant women over 18 years of age who are registered as unorganized workers.

fields.schemeName: Jharkhand State Scheduled Tribe Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The "Jharkhand State Scheduled Tribe Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme" aims to promote education and reduce dropout rates among Scheduled Tribe students. It provides financial assistance to students from Class 1st to 10th who are studying in government schools in Jharkhand.

fields.schemeName: Rani Durgavati and Shankarshah Puraskar Scheme (Reward Scheme for Meritorious Students)
fields.briefDescription: "Rani Durgavati and Shankarshah Puraskar Scheme (Reward Scheme for Meritorious Students)" provides awards ranging from ₹3,000/- to ₹51,000/- to the meritorious students from the Scheduled Tribe community based on their performance in the 10th and 12th board examinations.

fields.schemeName: Aatmanirbhar Gujarat Scheme for assistance to MSMEs: Assistance for Interest Subsidy to Micro, Small and Medium Enterprise (Service Sector)
fields.briefDescription: The "Aatmanirbhar Gujarat Scheme for assistance to MSMEs" aims to empower the state's dynamic MSME sector, which significantly contributes to employment, GDP, and exports.

fields.schemeName: Vandan Matru Yojana
fields.briefDescription: This scheme is a Gujarat government initiative providing financial assistance to pregnant and lactating women from economically weaker sections to promote maternal and child health.

fields.schemeName: Saksham Jharkhand Kaushal Vikas Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The "Saksham Jharkhand Kaushal Vikas Yojana" is an initiative by the Jharkhand government to equip youth aged 18-35 years with quality skills training aligned with the National Skills Qualification Framework (NSQF). The scheme aims to create job opportunities for 70% of successful trainees.

fields.schemeName: Jharkhand Sports Excellence Cash Award Scheme to Coaches
fields.briefDescription: The “Jharkhand Sports Excellence Cash Award Scheme to Coaches” aims to provide cash awards to coaches who train athletes and teams to achieve excellence in national and international competitions under the Jharkhand Sports Policy, 2022.

fields.schemeName: Shaheed Gram Vikas Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Shaheed Gram Vikas Yojana" by the Welfare Department, Government of Jharkhand, aims to develop villages linked to tribal freedom fighters. It provides housing, infrastructure, and other facilities to eligible Scheduled Tribes and Scheduled Castes.

fields.schemeName: PURNA Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to reduce malnutrition, anemia, and early marriage among adolescent girls in Gujarat by educating them on health, nutrition, life skills, and legal rights, while promoting self-empowerment through various activities.

fields.schemeName: Mahila Swavlamban Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provides financial assistance to women from rural and urban areas for undertaking economic activities, with support in the form of a subsidy and loans.

fields.schemeName: Chief Ministers House Rent
fields.briefDescription: The "Chief Minister's House Rent" scheme by the Department of De-notified, Nomadic, and Semi-Nomadic Welfare, Government of Madhya Pradesh, provides ₹1,000 to ₹2,000 per student per month in Bhopal, Indore, Jabalpur, Gwalior, and Ujjain.

fields.schemeName: Sugar Distribution Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The "Sugar Distribution Scheme" by the Department of Food, Public Distribution and Consumer Affairs, Government of Jharkhand, aims to provide subsidized sugar to AAY households under NFSA, ensuring access to essential food commodities at affordable rates.

fields.schemeName: Post Metric Scholarship (Denotified, Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic)
fields.briefDescription: The "Post-Metric Scholarship" scheme, implemented by the Department of Denotified, Nomadic, and Semi-Nomadic Welfare, Government of Madhya Pradesh, provides financial assistance to students from class 11 to college level, including medical, engineering, science other courses.

fields.schemeName: Pandit Deen Dayal Upadhyay Samoohik Pashudhan Beema Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Pandit Deen Dayal Upadhyay Samoohik Pashudhan Beema Yojana" aims to provide socio-economic security to livestock farmers in the state by covering livestock under an insurance scheme. Financial protection against the risk of loss due to animal death is extended to livestock owners.

fields.schemeName: Special Livestock Insurance Scheme
fields.briefDescription: "Special Livestock Insurance Scheme" is a welfare initiative targeting SC families engaged in livestock rearing. The scheme provides free insurance for livestock, enhancing the economic security of resource-poor SC families. The scheme covers milch animals, sheep, goats, pigs, camels, etc;

fields.schemeName: Scheme for Wage Compensation to Handloom Weaver Families
fields.briefDescription: "Scheme for Wage Compensation to Handloom Weaver Families" by the Dept. of Handlooms & Textiles, Andhra Pradesh aims to provide wage compensation relief to handloom weaver families. A relief assistance of ₹4,000 per weaver family is provided to compensate for wage loss during the rainy season.

fields.schemeName: Panchayat Secretariat Strengthening Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The "Panchayat Secretariat Strengthening Scheme" by the Panchayati Raj Department, Government of Jharkhand, aims to provide financial assistance of ₹15,000 per month to each Gram Panchayat for operational and maintenance purposes, ensuring efficient governance at the grassroots level.

fields.schemeName: Valmiki Chhatravritti Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The "Valmiki Chhatravritti Yojana" by the Department of Higher and Technical Education, Government of Jharkhand, aims to provide financial assistance and encouragement to orphaned and differently-abled students to pursue higher education and benefits include full tuition fee reimbursement.

fields.schemeName: INDIRAMMA Weavers Pension (Urban)
fields.briefDescription: "INDIRAMMA Weavers Pension (Urban)" scheme aims to provide monthly pensions to destitute weavers aged 50 years or above. To be eligible, they should be from a BPL family, and be a resident of Andhra Pradesh. The eligible individuals will be identified by their respective Ward Sabhas.

fields.schemeName: Haryana State Meritorious Incentive Scheme for the Students Who Attain First Position in CBSE Annual Exams in the State
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Haryana State Meritorious Incentive Scheme" aims to encourage meritorious students who attain top positions in CBSE annual exams by providing them with financial incentives. Selected students receive an annual incentive covering their school/college fees up to their graduation.

fields.schemeName: Free Books Scheme for Scheduled Caste Students Pursuing Higher Education
fields.briefDescription: The scheme was launched by the Department of Higher Education, Govt. of Haryana, on 1st July, 2008, with the aim of attracting SC students towards higher education. Under this scheme, SC students studying in govt. colleges will receive ₹2,000/- per annum for purchasing books.

fields.schemeName: Divyangjan Scholarship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: "Divyangjan Scholarship Scheme" provides financial assistance for the education and training of differently-abled children, who are regular students in a school or college. The application needs to be submitted to the District Office, Panchayat and Social Welfare / Janpad Panchayat Office.

fields.schemeName: Transport Loan Scheme
fields.briefDescription: "Transport Loan Scheme" aims to promote self-employment among target groups by providing term loans for Light Motor Vehicles. The scheme benefits Scheduled Castes, Other Backward Classes, Minorities, and Safai Karamcharis with financial assistance up to ₹5,00,000/-.

fields.schemeName: Composite Loan Scheme
fields.briefDescription: "Composite Loan Scheme" aims to provide need-based financial support to individuals from Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, Other Backward Classes, Minorities, and PwDs to help them pursue various income-generating activities. The scheme encourages self-employment and entrepreneurship.

fields.schemeName: Goa Mediclaim Scheme
fields.briefDescription: “Goa Mediclaim Scheme” provides financial assistance to avail super-speciality treatments that are not available in the Government Hospitals of Goa, such as dialysis, plastic surgery, ICU care, angiography and angioplasty, open-heart surgery, kidney transplantation, neurosurgery, etc.

fields.schemeName: Hostel Facility Scheme (HPBOCWWB)
fields.briefDescription: The Hostel Facility Scheme, introduced by the HPBOCWWB , provides financial assistance ranging from ₹15,000 to ₹20,000 annually. This support covers accommodation, boarding, and food expenses for the children of registered worker while they reside in a hostel.

fields.schemeName: Consolidated Stipend Scheme for Scheduled Caste Students Pursuing Higher Education
fields.briefDescription: The scheme was launched by the Department of Higher Education, Government of Haryana, on 1st July, 2008, with the aim of attracting SC students towards higher education. Under this scheme, SC students studying in Govt. Colleges will receive a stipend of ₹1,000 per month.
